Description: Micro-Fit 3.0 receptacle housing, 2 x 5, no panel ears; one per end
Micro-Fit 3.0 female crimp, 20-24 AWG, tin to match the headers, bagged; one per circuit at each end
Stranded wire, 20 AWG, insulation <= 1.85 mm OD (the crimp's limit), <= 300 mm; pin n to pin n
Cable tie, miniature, <= 2.5 mm wide, >= 140 mm long (e.g. Panduit PLT1.5M); one round each column of two cells at each tie slot pair
Silicone RTV, neutral cure (alkoxy or oxime, not acetoxy: its acetic acid corrodes the leads); a bead under each cell body
M3 screw and standoff, length to suit the enclosure; board holes are 3.2 mm
